smallest_supported_claim: The isolated, zero-credit night-setup run used the bound native clock and smartphone menus, then completed the native Save and Quit confirmation, reached the main menu, and completed the native application-quit confirmation. The resulting profile is a durable disposable nighttime setup copy; no ordinary gameplay credit is claimed.
causal_account: The advertised numeric prompt submission was accepted, the clock selector returned to World through its native cancellation route, and the carried smartphone was selected and its advertised menu command accepted. Before evidence sealing, the World owner advertised and accepted Save and Quit; its YES confirmation reached Main menu. Main-menu Quit and its YES confirmation then produced exit code 0. Read-only filesystem inspection after the save showed the world save, character save, map, and last-world files updated at the native quit time. This establishes a saved setup boundary, while the charter limits it to zero credit.
